messages: ellie (design): quick thread on playground chat toolbar + streaming affordances. want to settle layout (compact versus full-width), token prominence, and prompt library keyboard behavior before the next dev sprint. small UX + accessibility items too. ellie (design): attached two comps: compact toolbar (icons only, tokens collapsed) and spacious toolbar (label + token chip). opinions? maria (pm): context — analytics show users often ask where tokens are during heavy prompting. default should surface tokens but not be noisy. also regenerate usage spikes in 2nd week tests. anya (ux): thoughts: compact is cleaner visually, but discoverability suffers. propose hybrid: show "Tokens left" chip in compact, expand to full label on hover/focus. also animated transition only on expand to avoid motion for reduced-motion users. luke (a11y): prefer persistent text for screen reader users. if chip collapses visually, ensure an offscreen text node announces "Tokens left: X" and the chip has aria-expanded=false/true state when toggled. kevin (eng): implementation constraints: we already render token counts server-side for quota checks. front-end can toggle visual state. animated expand should respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS and use transform/opacity for perf. tom (frontend): code example for accessible chip toggler: ```html ``` we can keep label visually-hidden but present for screen readers. ellie (design): good. microcopy: should it be "Tokens left" or "Remaining tokens"? test copy. and when low show urgency tone: "Low tokens" + CTA "Shorten prompt". maria (pm): prefer "Tokens remaining" in telemetry logs (consistent with billing), but display copy can be shorter. ok with "Tokens left". anya (ux): note for contrast: chip background needs 4.5:1 text ratio when collapsed. when small we should add outline on focus and 3px min tap target. kevin (eng): stop vs regenerate placement: we've had debates. Another option: single primary floating action during streaming: toggles between Stop (while streaming) and Regenerate (when idle). keeps UI minimal. ellie (design): floating action works but may obscure prompt library or editor on small screens. propose floating on desktop only, and inline controls on mobile. tom (frontend): mobile note: iOS safari will hide fixed elements on scroll. better place controls within the prompt area on mobile. desktop floating can be anchored to bottom-right of chat pane with safe margin. luke (a11y): keyboard focus order is crucial. If floating action appears, it must be focusable in DOM order near the prompt input. do not inject at end of body which could trap screen reader users. kevin (eng): shortcut mapping: we tested Esc to stop; for regenerate, propose Shift+Enter as alternative to submit. conflict matrix: Cmd+R reserved by browser. document shortcuts in keyboard help overlay. anya (ux): prompt library: we discovered users want to insert templates without losing focus in the prompt. propose quick-insert = Enter when a library item is focused, and keep focus in input. Also spacebar toggles preview. ellie (design): design detail: when an item is inserted, show a subtle inline toast "Prompt added" with undo. for a11y, add sr-only announce: "Inserted prompt: {title}. Press Ctrl+Z to undo." Keep that separate from general notifications. tom (frontend): implementation plan for quick-insert: use input.setRangeText() at cursor and dispatch input event. will need to handle composition events and IME. kevin (eng): dev estimate: 1 week for token chip + helper, 1.5 weeks for floating/inline stop-regenerate and shortcuts, 2 weeks for prompt lib keyboard-first polish. can parallelize token chip + prompt lib. ellie (design): animation nits: prefer no shimmer when streaming — just reveal tokens and subtle pulse on Stop button when streaming long (>5s). also ensure no layout shift when token counts change length (use fixed-width numeric container). maria (pm): can we add a small telemetry event when users toggle token helper or use quick-insert? want to track discoverability. kevin (eng): yes, will add events: playground.token_helper.open, playground.insert_prompt.quick, playground.stop_stream, playground.regenerate_click. build-bot: automated note: updated UX checklist in project 4.2 board. Added labels: accessibility, keyboard-shortcuts, token-helper. ellie (design): final action items: 1) finalize chip copy = "Tokens left" visually, telemetry use "tokens_remaining"; 2) implement accessible offscreen token announcement; 3) floating action on desktop only + inline mobile controls; 4) prompt library quick-insert + sr-only insertion announcement + undo. I'll upload updated comps (compact + spacious) and a motion spec for reduced-motion in the design thread. maria (pm): +1. I'll slot tokens + prompt lib into next sprint cycle. anya (ux): +1 10 I'll push updated accessibility notes and keyboard map. tom (frontend): +1, will begin prototyping chip + quick-insert. kevin (eng): +1, will break into tickets and post estimates. ellie (design): thanks all, leaving this thread open for small follow-ups. :sparkles:
